verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 25 avenue Montaigne, 75008 Paris, within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Elysees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel is at 25 avenue Montaigne, 75008 Paris. It's within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower and Champs-Élysées.

verified_facts.text: Avenue Montaigne has a view of the Eiffel Tower at one end and the Champs-Elysees at the other.
verified_facts.excerpt: with a view of the Eiffel Tower at one end, and the Champs-Elysées at the other.

verified_facts.text: Avenue Montaigne hosts high-fashion flagships such as number 30, the historic building where Dior was founded in 1946.
verified_facts.excerpt: this avenue hosts flagships of high fashion such as number 30, the historic building where Dior was founded in 1946.

verified_facts.text: The Eurostar station, Gare du Nord, is 20 minutes from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Eurostar station, Gare du Nord, is just 20 minutes away from our five-star hotel

verified_facts.text: Le Relais Plaza is one of the city's last remaining Art Deco dining rooms, with a 1930s spirit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Le Relais Plaza is one of the city’s last remaining Art Deco dining rooms, and its glamorous 1930s spirit lives on.

verified_facts.text: Le Relais Plaza has original Diane Chasseresse frescoes, a Lalique chandelier and engraved zodiac stained glass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Look out for Diane Chasseresse’s original frescoes alongside Lalique’s spectacular chandelier and engraved zodiac stained glass.

verified_facts.text: Le Bar was redesigned in 2014 by Patrick Jouin and Sanjit Manku, with a deep blue fabric ceiling above a transparent bar made from a single block of resin.
verified_facts.excerpt: Redesigned in 2014 by Patrick Jouin and Sanjit Manku, a dreamlike ceiling of deep blue fabric swirls above a sleek, transparent bar, crafted from a single block of resin

verified_facts.text: Le Bar displays Dom Perignon champagnes in a display designed by Nicolas Francart.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dom Pérignon champagnes, in a striking display designed by Nicolas Francart.

verified_facts.text: La Grande Table du Plaza Athenee reinterprets ancient French recipes, some up to 250 years old.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our chefs celebrate France’s rich culinary legacy with a fresh take on ancient recipes, some up to 250 years old.

verified_facts.text: At La Grande Table, a Royal Table of antique Breccia pink marble sits in a room with 20,000 gold leaves and a gilded ceiling by designer Remi Tessier.
verified_facts.excerpt: Where everything centres around a grand Royal Table crafted from antique Breccia pink marble. Adorning the room with 20,000 gold leaves and a gilded ceiling, designer Remi Tessier

verified_facts.text: Le Cabinet des Conspirateurs is a private dining room set within the kitchen, behind glass doors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within our Michelin-starred kitchen and behind glass doors, a supremely private dining room awaits.

verified_facts.text: Restaurant director Denis Courtiade has spent more than 20 years at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: In more than 20 years at the hotel, Denis has created a signature style of service for his guests

verified_facts.text: Executive pastry chef Angelo Musa won the World Pastry Chef award and was the 2007 Meilleur Ouvrier de France.
verified_facts.excerpt: Executive pastry chef Angelo Musa is a winner of the World Pastry Chef award and 2007 winner of ‘Meilleur Ouvrier de France’.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served daily at La Galerie.
verified_facts.excerpt: Afternoon tea is served daily at La Galerie.

verified_facts.text: La Galerie has harp music during the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: happily passing the day under the gentle melodies of harps and soft conversation.

verified_facts.text: Designer Bruno Moinard created La Galerie's interior, linking it to the courtyard with light and a mosaic floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: To create a link between this sophisticated space and the courtyard beyond the window, designer Bruno Moinard blends light and decoration

verified_facts.text: La Cour Jardin is set in the leafy courtyard and serves cuisine in spring and summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Cour Jardin is set in our leafy courtyard, serving sunkissed cuisine in spring and summer.

verified_facts.text: The courtyard has signature parasols in Plaza red.
verified_facts.excerpt: punctuated by our signature parasols in that splendid ‘Plaza red’.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has its own fruit chef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Did you know we have our own fruit chef?

verified_facts.text: Two bakers start the bread at 3am to bring fresh rolls every morning.
verified_facts.excerpt: The life of our bread begins at 3am, as our two bakers knead and shape the dough to bring fresh rolls to our guests every morning.

verified_facts.text: Sunday brunch includes pastries, seasonal fruits, hot drinks and champagne.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Sunday brunch menu includes pastries, seasonal fruits, hot drinks and champagne

verified_facts.text: The hotel operates its spa in partnership with Dior.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hôtel Plaza Athénée operates the spa, in partnership with Dior.

verified_facts.text: The Dior Light Suite is a light therapy room with circadian-supportive lighting and treatments to help rebalance the sleep cycle.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique light therapy room features circadian-supportive lighting alongside curated treatments to help rebalance the sleep cycle and boost energy.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre has a sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: simply a chance to unwind in the sauna, our fitness centre caters for every motivation.

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Room comes in two styles: classic Parisian or Art Deco.
verified_facts.excerpt: A single room type, two distinct atmospheres. Will you be drawn to the refined allure of classic Parisian style, or the striking flair of Art Deco?

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite combines couture-house fabrics with eclectic vintage finds.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Presidential Suite combines couture-house fabrics with eclectic, vintage finds

verified_facts.text: The Prestige Suite was designed by Marie-Jose Pommereau.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Marie-José Pommereau, this exquisite suite perfectly harmonises elegant Parisian décor and sumptuous comfort.

verified_facts.text: An extra bed for children younger than 13 is complimentary.
verified_facts.excerpt: An extra bed for children younger than 13 is complimentary.

verified_facts.text: Up to two small dogs under 7 kg are welcome per room, for a daily fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, we welcome up to two small dogs (under 7 kg/15 lbs) per room, at €40 per day to cover deep cleaning.

verified_facts.text: At La Grande Table elegant attire is requested; a jacket is recommended for gentlemen and caps, shorts and sportswear are not permitted.
verified_facts.excerpt: For gentlemen, a jacket is recommended: please note we don't permit caps, shorts or sportswear.

verified_facts.text: Le Bar does not admit unaccompanied children.
verified_facts.excerpt: No unaccompanied children

verified_facts.text: All of the hotel's energy comes from renewable sources such as wind and solar.
verified_facts.excerpt: 100% of our energy comes from renewable sources such as wind and solar.

verified_facts.text: The hotel underwent a renovation in 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: During our renovation in 2025, we donated a variety of materials to Parisian fashion schools
